about: What the review of an offer for Koona's checked list refuses that a form can see before it is sent, written from the review's own code in the app's add-ons crate. The codes are the review's.

license_file.apache_terms: TERMS AND CONDITIONS FOR USE, REPRODUCTION, AND DISTRIBUTION
license_file.name: LICENSE.md
license_file.rule: The file at the add-on's root, UTF-8 and not blank. With the white space at both ends trimmed it is more than more_than_bytes bytes, and holds none of placeholders (in any case), no todo in upper case as a whole word, and none of apache_placeholders (in any case) unless it also holds apache_terms (in any case).

placeholder_author.name: Your Name
placeholder_author.rule: author.name, with the white space at both ends trimmed, equal to name in any case.

placeholder_host.rule: A host, in lower case, that is one of the domains or ends with "." and one of them. Every host the manifest names counts: permissions.network.hosts, permissions.links.hosts, a book action's host, the host of the sign-in's issuer, authorize, token and revoke, and of homepage, source, support and author.url.

placeholder_id.rule: An id that starts with one of the prefixes, or is one of them without its last dot, is a starter's.
